fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck driveway connects to Mooresville Blvd as an open, uncontrolled drive. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in satellite imagery; Street View (2026-01) does not reach the entrance. Site is mid-expansion which adds uncertainty.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth resolvable at the entrance. A small standalone office-type building sits near the road frontage but is the plant office, not an entrance guard shack.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access drive from the road wraps to the SW drop yard / dock face; ample queue room.
fieldNotes.dropArea: SW drop yard holds trailers parked nose-out in roughly 3 long rows - 50+ stalls in the cleaner (pre-expansion) imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors along the SW long face of the building with trailers backed in; ~35 estimated, banded 25-50. Active construction obscures a precise count.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open driveway and large paved/graded yard with no existing control structure - room to add a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Large parcel (~22 ac) but boundaries are fluid due to ongoing expansion / land clearing on the SE side.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Borderline. Mooresville is in the Charlotte-Concord-Gastonia metro; the immediate stretch of Mooresville Blvd is a cluster of large warehouses/distribution buildings. Called Urban on the metro + warehouse-cluster basis, though woodland surrounds the parcel.
fieldNotes.expansion: Niagara is actively expanding the Mooresville plant - 2026-01 imagery shows extensive land clearing and a construction laydown yard on the SE side.
